Arctic.fact: === Territorial claims === While there are several ongoing territorial claims in the Arctic, no country owns the geographic North Pole or the region of the Arctic Ocean surrounding it. Two Arctic states (Finland and Sweden) do not have direct access to the Arctic Ocean.  Upon ratification of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, a country has ten years to make claims to an extended continental shelf beyond its 200 nautical mile zone.
